decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY extending the clean-editing standard to monthly clip production; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY adding the provided B-roll and requiring it alongside the long-form YouTube source for the current batch.
The 45-to-60-second duration and monthly-production scope were already established before this source Event, so the repeated rule does not change the candidate state.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY adding the new-viewer comprehension criterion, while its complete-lesson and standalone requirements were already established.
The source reiterates complete lessons or stories but does not change the candidate's distinct standard for selecting strong and impactful source moments.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering the Drive-folder submission method, access setting, batch size, deadline, consequence, and obsolete submission-content removal.
Client review before publication is already required by the candidate; the Friday timing is a batch publication schedule rather than a change to the approval gate.
The source requests a separate five-clip batch and does not modify or resume the deferred requirement for 100 approved clips per month.
The source specifies production standards for five clips and makes no decision about Lead Clipper training, advancement, compensation, or responsibilities.
The five clips are described as real clips intended to go live, not as a replacement qualification trial or a modification of the prior qualification criteria.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the Friday publication schedule and the consequence of missing the Thursday-morning delivery deadline.
